requirement.statement: The web server SHALL accept injected trusted DomainContext registrations, load each bundle once, derive id and version only from its catalog context, reject duplicate context ids, freeze server-current capabilities separately from authoring facts, and expose explicit contract-owned context, catalog, operation, timeline capability, and complete preset request projections without leaking seed, bindings, handlers, probes, functions, database resources, or mutable execution state.

case.given: an app with zero or multiple unique registrations including temporal and non-temporal bundles
case.then: stable direct DTOs SHALL list and resolve only registered public catalog facts

case.given: two registrations whose bundle catalogs share one context id
case.then: creation SHALL reject the duplicate even when versions differ

case.given: a bundle containing timeline declarations, complete preset timelines, seed, bindings, handlers, and probes
case.then: only enumerated contract DTO fields plus current capabilities SHALL be present and no function or runtime state SHALL leak

case.given: as-of, effective-on, and range operations and preset requests
case.then: timeline granularity, modes, required flag, mode-specific days, and optional recordedAt SHALL be cloned exactly enough to parse and catalog-match

case.when: a context-scoped GET route is requested
case.then: HTTP 404 SHALL return the stable DOMAIN_CONTEXT_NOT_FOUND transport shape

requirement.statement: The execute route SHALL resolve context through projected request facts, pass the original parsed body object unchanged to the matching runtime bundle with its frozen server-current capabilities, return every runtime success, partial, or failure envelope as HTTP 200, and produce truthful contract failure envelopes with no fallback bundle or invented facts for missing, invalid, unknown, version-mismatched, or timeline-incompatible contexts.

case.given: a complete temporal or non-temporal preset request fetched from the catalog
case.when: that JSON object is posted without edits
case.then: the runtime SHALL receive the same request values and execution SHALL return a contract response matching direct bundle execution

case.given: a request with missing or structurally invalid context
case.then: HTTP 200 SHALL return REQUEST_VALIDATION_FAILED with independently projected nullable facts, no commit, no mutations, and null tree

case.given: a well-formed unknown context id, non-active version, or incompatible timeline
case.then: HTTP 200 SHALL return OPERATION_CATALOG_MISMATCH without selecting or allocating another bundle

case.given: a runtime success, partial, or business/execution failure
case.then: the unchanged response envelope SHALL be returned with HTTP 200
